risk_note: RV2 (linking/**, app.module.ts; attribution). Linking module first build: registers a link and its quote snapshot for each card (implements catalog's LinkRegistrar and SourceLinkReader, wired in app.module); identity snapshot with the user, platform, pid_scene derived from scene and the earliest active pid (registration goes on with an empty pid when none is active); entry_source and expire_at; CallerContext, attr_code lookup and config ports (guest and unavailable until B1-02m wires identity; user_id never stands in for attr_code); the taolijin switch reads true or 'on'; price anomalies (union isPriceAnomaly) are never registered; writes to links with the CAS of migration 0006. A new link_id per card: quote snapshots are never reused (BR-PRICE-12 leaves reuse to the implementer; both reviews judged it compliant with the D33 rule that a coupon id string, coupon_fen or price change needs a new snapshot, and with no reuse across scenes). Written by hand.
